items.rule: 从句里主语在前、动词在后，不用疑问语序。
items.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?
items.right: Can you tell me where the station is?

items.rule: 主句是过去时，从句一般也用过去时。
和 or not 连用时只用 whether。
items.wrong: I don't know if he comes or not.
items.right: I don't know whether he comes or not.

items.rule: 先行词是人时，关系代词用 who 或 that。
items.wrong: The man which called you is my uncle.
items.right: The man who called you is my uncle.

items.rule: 先行词是物时，关系代词用 which 或 that。
items.wrong: The book who I bought is good.
items.right: The book which I bought is good.

items.rule: 先行词是地点，且从句缺地点状语，用 where。
items.wrong: The city where I born is small.
items.right: The city where I was born is small.

items.rule: 介词后面指物只能用 which，不能用 that。
items.wrong: The house in that he lives is old.
items.right: The house in which he lives is old.

items.point: 时间状语从句用一般现在时
items.rule: when 从句说将来时，用一般现在时代替 will。
items.wrong: When I will finish, I will call you.
items.right: When I finish, I will call you.

items.rule: unless 相当于 if not，从句里不再加 don't。
items.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, we will be late.
items.right: Unless you hurry, we will be late.

items.point: because 与 so 不连用
items.rule: because 和 so 只用其中一个，不能同时出现。
items.wrong: Because it rained, so we stayed home.
items.right: Because it rained, we stayed home.

items.point: 主语从句用 it 占位
items.rule: 真正的主语太长时，用 it 放在句首占位。
items.wrong: Is important that we start early.
items.right: It is important that we start early.

items.point: although 与 but 不连用
items.rule: although 和 but 只能留一个。
items.wrong: Although he is young, but he is wise.
items.right: Although he is young, he is wise.

items.rule: so...that 的结果从句时态要和主句一致。
items.wrong: He was so tired that he can't walk.
items.right: He was so tired that he couldn't walk.

items.rule: The problem is that... 不用 because 引导表语从句。
items.wrong: The problem is because we have no time.
items.right: The problem is that we have no time.

items.point: 疑问词从句用陈述语序
items.rule: I wonder / I don't know 后面接陈述语序。
items.wrong: I wonder what time is it.
items.right: I wonder what time it is.
